tasks.title: Return altitude in AT_LEAST mode
tasks.statement: `nav_rth_alt_mode = AT_LEAST`, `nav_rth_altitude = {a}`. RTH is activated at **{h} m** above the takeoff point. At what altitude (m) does the aircraft head home?
tasks.solution: `nav_rth_altitude` is set in centimeters. AT_LEAST is like FIXED, but climb only: below the set altitude the aircraft climbs to it, above — it stays at the current one. The answer is the larger of the two numbers.

tasks.title: Return altitude in EXTRA mode
tasks.statement: `nav_rth_alt_mode = EXTRA`, `nav_rth_altitude = {a}`. RTH is activated at an altitude of **{h} m**. At what altitude (m) does the aircraft head home?
tasks.solution: EXTRA is the current altitude plus `nav_rth_altitude` (in centimeters). With a large addition this is exactly the symptom “RTH climbs into the sky”.
